description: Scan an email subject and body (plain text or HTML) for spam-trigger phrases by category, ALL-CAPS, exclamation runs, emoji, URL shorteners and image-heavy HTML. Returns a low/medium/high risk reading and, optionally, a rule-based rewrite.

rewrite.description: Also return a calmer rewrite of the subject (and of a plain-text body).

name: check_spam_words
title: Email copy spam check
